import hashlib, json, re
from html import unescape
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/world-bank-buyer-acceptance')
raw = (root / 'raw/procurement-feed.json').read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '4f320b60ed83b0861f177faad315db7fb9298263930c88a1feb91ea3fb306e73'
notices = json.loads(raw)['procnotices']
assert isinstance(notices, list) and all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in notices)
pattern = re.compile(r'\b(data quality|data validation|data migration|data cleaning|digitization|digitisation|technical documentation|data management|database|quality assurance|donn[ée]es|documentaci[oó]n)\b', re.I)
rows = []
for row in notices:
    fields = ('bid_description', 'project_name', 'notice_text')
    matches = sorted({m.group().lower() for key in fields for m in pattern.finditer(unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]*>', ' ', str(row.get(key) or ''))))})
    rows.append({'notice_id': row.get('id'), 'notice_type_as_reported': row.get('notice_type'), 'status_as_reported': row.get('notice_status'), 'keyword_matches': matches})
result = {'source_sha256': digest, 'notice_objects_screened': len(rows), 'rows': rows, 'scope': 'One saved page. Keywords identify leads only. Open status, scope, eligibility and acceptance require original-notice verification.'}
path = root / 'director-notice-screen.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps({'notice_objects_screened': len(rows), 'matching_rows': sum(bool(row['keyword_matches']) for row in rows), 'artifact': str(path)}))
